title: First Indian woman Olympic medalist
subject: History
caption: Karnam Malleswari with her 2000 Olympic bronze medal.
altText: Photorealistic portrait of Karnam Malleswari, the first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal, standing against a plain white background. She wears a simple Indian-style top, and holds a bronze Olympic medal in her right hand. The medal is clearly visible and labeled with the event and year (Bronze Medal – Women's 69 kg Weightlifting, Sydney 2000). A label points to her face with her name, and a small Indian flag icon is labeled "India". The illustration is high resolution, accurate, and suitable for an educational textbook.
